_comment: The hand-owned half of the board. Everything here is a judgement a human makes; everything NOT here is derived by render-board.mjs from source files or scripts. Keep it small: if a value can be computed, compute it instead of typing it.
stage: Stage 3 — one source table, then prevention
headline: Stage 3's 13 slices are merged and live on staging. The work now is finishing the remaining spec items on staging; production has not moved since 2026-09-07 and is not scheduled to.

waiting_on_owner.ask: May a config-only production deploy (no build) run in any evening window, rather than only the weekly release?
waiting_on_owner.why: The weekly rule exists to limit BUILDS on the 2-vCPU box that serves production. A config deploy copies one JSON file and restarts nothing, so the cost it guards against is absent.
waiting_on_owner.blocks: Nothing today. Decide before the first prod config change.

waiting_on_owner.ask: How old may a field's last-confirmed date get before the page marks it stale?
waiting_on_owner.recommend: 7 days for document-sourced fields, 1 day for live figures
waiting_on_owner.why: Item 21 is stuck at PARTIAL only because this number has no value. It is an owner decision, not a build.

waiting_on_owner.ask: Production is 16 migrations behind (4 tables, 12 columns, 14 indexes, 6 constraints missing). Rehearse the batch against a prod-shaped copy before the release?
waiting_on_owner.why: The 16 have never been run as ONE batch against prod's exact schema. Individually each is cheap at current row counts; as a batch, untested.

environments.note: Behind main. 16 migrations unapplied — ipo_field_plan, field_extraction_failures, field_source_overrides, document_pages do not exist here.
All 16 migrations applied; 4 minor drift findings. This is the release gate — the bar is feature-complete here, not a green build.
The one sanctioned local Postgres, reached on localhost:15432 through the tunnel. Integration and real-writer tests run here.

release.window: One production window per day, ~21:00–23:30 IST, owner-worded only.
release.branch: Prod deploys only from a frozen release/prod-<date> branch, never from main.
release.contents: Not cut. The next release must carry the 16 pending migrations first, then the stage 3 slices.
release.rollback: gh workflow run deploy-linux.yml --ref release/prod-<previous> -f slot=prod; config-only changes roll back with deploy-config.sh and the previous sha.

gates.name: PR gate (lint, types, unit)
gates.detail: Green on main. The only workflow that runs on a PR.

gates.name: Integration / E2E
gates.detail: workflow_dispatch only — does NOT run on a PR. A green PR gate is not a green CI.

gates.name: Swap Test (stage acceptance)
gates.detail: NEVER RUN. Both config paths are unblocked in principle; neither has been executed on staging. Stage 3 is not done until it passes.

gates.name: Detection floor
gates.detail: 21 of 26 pull/re-read checks are designed-not-built (#778). 5 NEW findings in last night's delta.

gates.name: Build-card gate
gates.detail: Accepts Status: unknown as valid, which is why 24 of 42 cards say nothing (#810).

reader_impact.what: Issue size is 41–76% too low on 6 of 6 live IPOs
reader_impact.plain: A reader comparing two IPOs sees one of them far smaller than it really is. On a ₹500 crore issue the page can show roughly ₹150 crore.
reader_impact.status: Queued LAST, deliberately: the verification that would prove it stays fixed does not exist yet.

reader_impact.plain: Where two sources disagree the reader is shown one value with no sign anything is in doubt. The oldest has been open 96 days.
reader_impact.status: The prevention model stops new ones. Draining the old pile is the admin queue (S9, queued).

reader_impact.what: Every fix of the last 13 days is invisible to readers
reader_impact.plain: 197 fix and feature commits are on main and not on the live site, because production has not deployed since 2026-09-07.
reader_impact.status: By design — the owner's bar is feature-complete staging before a prod window.

lines: The board is now fully generated: the page, its vitals and all 282 tracked rows come from source files, so it cannot drift from the spec (#850).
Items 18 and 22 were re-measured and found already BUILT, and item 6 was corrected from "4 fetchers wired" to "3 fetchers registered" (#848, #851) — the published page had been showing a stale claim.
The staleness gate now SHOWS what differs (character, line, both sides) instead of printing only "board is stale". That one opaque line cost four CI rounds on #850.
A generated-file merge rule landed so two PRs editing different rows of the tracking table no longer conflict line-by-line (#852).

now.Landed: Stage 3's 13 slices are all merged. Since the last board: #841 (the tracking-section generator), #844, #848 (items 18 and 22 re-measured as already built). Staging serves 61808af1.
now.Next: Wave 1 runs first and in parallel — items 34 and 35 in progress, then 8, 19, the S6 churn-stop (#759) and the Swap Test (items 18 and 22 were re-measured as already BUILT in #848). Then item 6, then 9, then 10, then 17 and 11. Item 14 (#728) goes last by the owner's rule: verification before correctness.
now.Blocked: OD-62 reason codes (field_extraction_failures holds zero rows) gate OD-63's admin queue. The Swap Test has never been run, and it is the stage's own acceptance test.
